Their stall in the Alban Souk is less a stall and more a theater set: draped fabric in iridescent materials, a mirror framed in flickering ELF-light strips, and a rotating display of pigment-patch samples, pattern-iris contacts, and small gene-treatment vials in color-coded cases.

They love transformation â€” the specific moment when someone looks in the mirror and becomes more themselves. core_fears: Being made to be only one thing â€” fixed, unchangeable, categorized
Doing a treatment that genuinely harms someone

The client didn't report it â€” couldn't afford the legal process â€” but SÃ¸ren knows and has been obsessively researching the batch source ever since, terrified to sell from that supplier but not yet certain which lot was contaminated.

speech_patterns.cadence: Quick, layered with parenthetical enthusiasm. Tends to complete their own interruptions.
verbal_tics: Gestures at themselves as a reference point constantly
example_lines: 'Okay but LOOK â€” what you actually want is something that moves with your natural undertone, not fights it. This amber patch would eat you alive. Try the copper.'
'I'm not a clinic, I'm not going to pretend I'm a clinic. But I know these kits better than half the Helix techs because I have tested every single one on myself first.'

'Someone was in here last week wanting to look completely different by Friday. That's not fashion, that's fear. I sold her something subtle and told her to come back when she knew what she actually wanted.'

story_hooks: They are quietly investigating the contaminated batch that damaged their client's vision, and need someone with supply chain access or Mesh skills to trace it back to the source.

A corporate fashion scout has approached them with an offer â€” Tessera wants to legitimize their aesthetic and hire them as a 'street-trend consultant.' SÃ¸ren is tempted and ashamed of being tempted and hasn't told anyone.

Knows the Souk's social ecosystem intimately â€” who is trying to change their appearance and why, who has new money, who is running from something. decision_rules: Never sell something you haven't tested or verified yourself
Be honest about risk even if it costs you a sale
Don't ask why someone wants to change â€” that's their business
escalation_ladder: Asking them to leave the stall
Flagging the situation to neighboring vendors

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and commercially attentive â€” every stranger is a potential canvas and a potential client.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal, occasionally overwhelming, will redesign your entire look unprompted if they think you're in a rut.

stress_responses.medium: Goes very still and quiet, which is alarming to anyone who knows them
stress_responses.high: Changes their own hair color mid-conversation without acknowledging it

contradictions: Deeply committed to safety and informed consent, but suppressing knowledge of a harm they caused
habits: Photographs every client transformation with permission and archives it obsessively
Tastes a fingertip of any new pigment compound before selling it â€” an old testing habit
Leaves Mesh-light offerings at a small ELF shrine built into the mirror frame
